---
name: Add a deployment
about: List where you run sos-beacon on the WHERE-SOS-BEACON-RUNS board
title: "[deployment] <your name or org>"
labels: deployment
---

Running sos-beacon somewhere? Add it to the board. A pull request to [`WHERE-SOS-BEACON-RUNS.md`](../../WHERE-SOS-BEACON-RUNS.md) is the fastest path, but if you'd rather we add it, fill this in and we will.

- **Who:** <your name or org>
- **Where it runs:** <platform + architecture, e.g. "a GitHub Actions cron" or "a Raspberry Pi">
- **What for:** <the beacon: what topic it watches and where it posts>
- **Flavor:** <container or binary; the image tag you run, e.g. `immersivefusion/sos-beacon:0.1.0`; one-shot or always-on>
- **Link:** <optional but encouraged: a public channel, blog post, or repo; it's the best proof>

Keep it factual and specific: no marketing. The specifics are the merit.
